name: Seth MacFarlane's Cavalcade of Cartoon Comedy

paragraphs.text: Seth MacFarlane's Cavalcade of Cartoon Comedy is an American adult animated web series created by Seth MacFarlane.

This series is a compilation of animated sketches released on YouTube. The series, which aired several episodes a month, was originally sponsored by Burger King, who sponsored the first 10 shorts, with videos appearing on their official channel. The series was then sponsored by Priceline.com, and finally, Nike. There are a total of 50 episodes. It saw a successful launch on MacFarlane's YouTube channel, SethComedy, which became the most watched YouTube channel of the week, generating three million video views within two days of the first episode's release.
